technical_and_design_decisions: Use Maven multi-module project structure in s-c-d to separate external library dependencies and test rules into dedicated sub-modules.
Implement classpath precedence rules in the packaging plugin (e.g., Spring Boot Maven Plugin or Shade Plugin) to prevent external libraries from overriding uber-jar internal classes.
Port SFTP source module from Spring XD by adapting Spring Integration SFTP adapters to the Spring Cloud Stream binder programming model.
Introduce an `offline` flag in `AetherModuleResolver` that configures Eclipse Aether / Maven Resolver session to operate purely against local repository cache.
Define a clear `ModuleRegistry` abstraction for module coordinate lookups and implement an in-memory/persistent backing store for registry state.
Implement CLI/Shell commands using Spring Shell annotations, wiring them directly to the `ModuleRegistry` service interface.
assumptions: Development and testing will be performed by a single developer proficient in Java, Spring Framework, Spring Cloud Stream, and Spring Cloud Data Flow.
Local integration testing infrastructure (e.g., embedded Redis, local SFTP test servers, local Maven repos) is available or easily configurable.
The codebase uses standard Spring build conventions (Maven/Gradle) compatible with Java 17+.
Effort includes unit testing, integration testing, code refactoring, and documentation for all 8 user stories.

activities.activity_description: Set up build configuration changes, manage sub-module dependencies, and lay down architecture for modularizing external libraries and test rules.

activities.activity_name: U1 & U2: External Library Isolation and Classpath Control
activities.activity_description: Move the external library into a dedicated project within the s-c-d repo and enforce dependency resolution rules to prevent external libraries from overriding uber-jar internal libraries.
Port the SFTP module from Spring XD to spring-cloud-stream repository as a streaming pipeline source module, including test setup with local SFTP server.

activities.activity_name: U4: RedisRule Isolation and Testing Commons Creation
activities.activity_description: Extract `@RedisRule` and associated contract test rules into an isolated project/module (such as SI commons) for reuse across test suites.

activities.activity_name: U5: OOTB Processor Modules Foundation Support
activities.activity_description: Develop core infrastructure and configuration foundation to enable processor modules as out-of-the-box (OOTB) streaming components in s-c-s-m repository.
Extend `AetherModuleResolver` with offline capabilities, bypassing remote Maven repository calls and resolving artifacts strictly from local Maven repositories.
Design and implement the `ModuleRegistry` interface and standard implementation for looking up, storing, and resolving module coordinates by name.

activities.activity_name: U8: Module Management CLI Commands Integration
activities.activity_description: Implement `module info`, `module list`, `module register`, and `module unregister` commands in the CLI/shell layer, integrating them with `ModuleRegistry`.
Perform full integration verification across s-c-d, s-c-s, and module repos, write documentation, and ensure build pipelines pass cleanly.
